component.name: Cake Wallet (community arm64 build)
component.summary: Unofficial build of the noncustodial multi-currency Cake Wallet

description.p: Community, unofficial Flatpak of Cake Wallet for aarch64 Linux phones and tablets (postmarketOS, Phosh, Plasma Mobile). It packages the Flutter Linux build of Cake Wallet with an adaptive layout for small portrait screens.
Not affiliated with or supported by Cake Labs. Cake Wallet is MIT licensed.
First build published to the shared isyourbrainfoss Flatpak repository.
